key_points: Nvidia announced a record $150B share repurchase authorization, the largest in US history.
The buyback signals strong confidence in intrinsic value and ample free cash flow.
Rosenblatt Securities reaffirmed its Buy rating, supporting positive analyst sentiment.
Mixed institutional flows observed, but net effect is overshadowed by the buyback news.
The repurchase could provide price support and reduce share count over the coming quarters.
